pairs.evidence: app/_lib/ats/connections-store.ts:244 Context and repository searches found custody of supplied secrets and delivery-attempt leases, but no ATS credential issuer or matches for lease_duration, revokeCredential or mintCredential, so this subject's issuance precondition does not hold.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/ats-config-store.ts:248 The signing secret is supplied by the caller and encrypted locally; this path creates no remote credential whose expiry must exceed a lease.
app/_lib/ats/connections-store.ts:327 Connection removal deletes local configuration; it is not a revocation callback for a credential minted by this context.
app/_lib/ats-delivery-store.ts:146 The leased artifact is a delivery attempt identified by event and entry, not an issued credential or certificate.
app/_lib/ats/connections-store.ts:244 The store encrypts an existing caller-supplied API token; it performs no credential provisioning or minted-token handout.
